verses.text: A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath Leannoth. A Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite. O LORD, the God of my salvation, day and night I cry out before You.

xrefs.text: Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation.”
I cry out by day, O my God, but You do not answer, and by night, but I have no rest.
Will not God bring about justice for His elect who cry out to Him day and night? Will He delay in helping them?
Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.
For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath. A Maskil of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their ways are vile. There is no one who does good.

verses.text: May my prayer come before You; incline Your ear to my cry.

xrefs.text: Incline Your ear to me; come quickly to my rescue. Be my rock of refuge, the stronghold of my deliverance.
A Psalm of David. I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.
Even when I cry out and plead for help, He shuts out my prayer.
May the groans of the captives reach You; by the strength of Your arm preserve those condemned to death.
When a man sins against his neighbor and is required to take an oath, and he comes to take an oath before Your altar in this temple,

verses.text: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.

xrefs.text: They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.
He has filled me with bitterness; He has intoxicated me with wormwood.
He took with Him Peter, James, and John, and began to be deeply troubled and distressed.
For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.
He was despised and rejected by men, a man of sorrows, acquainted with grief. Like one from whom men hide their faces, He was despised, and we esteemed Him not.

verses.text: I am counted among those descending to the Pit. I am like a man without strength.

xrefs.text: Of David. To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.
Indeed, we felt we were under the sentence of death, in order that we would not trust in ourselves, but in God, who raises the dead.
I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.
Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.
Surely for my own welfare I had such great anguish; but Your love has delivered me from the pit of oblivion, for You have cast all my sins behind Your back.

verses.text: I am forsaken among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more, who are cut off from Your care.

xrefs.text: By oppression and judgment He was taken away, and who can recount His descendants? For He was cut off from the land of the living; He was stricken for the transgression of My people.
In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from Your sight!” But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help.
He remembered us in our low estate His loving devotion endures forever.
Sheol beneath is eager to meet you upon your arrival. It stirs the spirits of the dead to greet you— all the rulers of the earth. It makes all the kings of the nations rise from their thrones.
So when God destroyed the cities of the plain, He remembered Abraham, and He brought Lot out of the catastrophe that destroyed the cities where he had lived.

verses.text: You have laid me in the lowest Pit, in the darkest of the depths.

xrefs.text: Do not let the floods engulf me or the depths swallow me up; let not the Pit close its mouth over me.
For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.
I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in Me should remain in darkness.
For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.
He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.

verses.text: Your wrath weighs heavily upon me; all Your waves have submerged me. Selah

xrefs.text: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.
He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree, so that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. “By His stripes you are healed.”
But because of your hard and unrepentant heart, you are storing up wrath against yourself for the day of wrath, when God’s righteous judgment will be revealed.
For the arrows of the Almighty have pierced me; my spirit drinks in their poison; the terrors of God are arrayed against me.
For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.

verses.text: You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.

xrefs.text: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends— they flee when they see me on the street.
They abhor me and keep far from me; they do not hesitate to spit in my face.

Thus says the LORD, the Redeemer and Holy One of Israel, to Him who was despised and abhorred by the nation, to the Servant of rulers: “Kings will see You and rise, and princes will bow down, because of the LORD, who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen You.”
At that time the army of the king of Babylon was besieging Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was imprisoned in the courtyard of the guard, which was in the palace of the king of Judah.

“I have trodden the winepress alone, and no one from the nations was with Me. I trampled them in My anger and trod them down in My fury; their blood spattered My garments, and all My clothes were stained.

verses.text: My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.

xrefs.text: As for you, if you direct your heart and lift up your hands to Him,
My heart pounds, my strength fails, and even the light of my eyes has faded.
Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.
I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah
My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”

verses.text: Do You work wonders for the dead? Do departed spirits rise up to praise You? Selah

xrefs.text: For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?
Your dead will live; their bodies will rise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust! For your dew is like the dew of the morning, and the earth will bring forth her dead.
For Sheol cannot thank You; Death cannot praise You. Those who descend to the Pit cannot hope for Your faithfulness.
“What gain is there in my bloodshed, in my descent to the Pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?
in an instant, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.

verses.text: Can Your loving devotion be proclaimed in the grave, Your faithfulness in Abaddon

xrefs.text: Sheol and Abaddon lie open before the LORD— how much more the hearts of men!

Now there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them— bringing swift destruction on themselves.
Surely You set them on slick ground; You cast them down into ruin.
Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.
But You, O God, will bring them down to the Pit of destruction; men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days. But I will trust in You.

verses.text: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, or Your righteousness in the land of oblivion?

xrefs.text: For the living know that they will die, but the dead know nothing. They have no further reward, because the memory of them is forgotten.
But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
They are wild waves of the sea, foaming up their own shame; wandering stars, for whom blackest darkness has been reserved forever.
I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.
Then too, I saw the burial of the wicked who used to go in and out of the holy place, and they were praised in the city where they had done so. This too is futile.

verses.text: But to You, O LORD, I cry for help; in the morning my prayer comes before You.

xrefs.text: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.
Early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up and went out to a solitary place to pray.
O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.
I rise before dawn and cry for help; in Your word I have put my hope.

verses.text: Why, O LORD, do You reject me? Why do You hide Your face from me?

xrefs.text: Why do You hide Your face and consider me as Your enemy?
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?
Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?
For You are the God of my refuge. Why have You rejected me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?
About the ninth hour Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani? which means, “My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?”

verses.text: From my youth I was afflicted and near death. I have borne Your terrors; I am in despair.

xrefs.text: For the arrows of the Almighty have pierced me; my spirit drinks in their poison; the terrors of God are arrayed against me.
And in His anguish, He prayed more earnestly, and His sweat became like drops of blood falling to the ground.
Therefore I will not restrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
For I am afflicted all day long and punished every morning.

Yet it was the LORD’s will to crush Him and to cause Him to suffer; and when His soul is made a guilt offering, He will see His offspring, He will prolong His days, and the good pleasure of the LORD will prosper in His hand.

verses.text: Your wrath has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.

xrefs.text: For the great day of Their wrath has come, and who is able to withstand it?
Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree.”
because of Your indignation and wrath, for You have picked me up and cast me aside.
How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
Surely He took up our infirmities and carried our sorrows; yet we considered Him stricken, struck down by God, and afflicted.

verses.text: All day long they engulf me like water; they enclose me on every side.

xrefs.text: For dogs surround me; a band of evil men encircles me; they have pierced my hands and feet.
The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.
For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Lilies.” Of David. Save me, O God, for the waters are up to my neck.
Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.
then the floods would have engulfed us, then the torrent would have overwhelmed us,

verses.text: You have removed my beloved and my friend; darkness is my closest companion.

xrefs.text: You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.
My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.
His troops advance together; they construct a ramp against me and encamp around my tent.
Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends— they flee when they see me on the street.
